confidence_policy: Do not transfer or recalibrate baseline scores. New proposals require new independent review.
comparison_policy: Development regression only; source/control/candidate identities and membership preserved. Proposal suppression is not measured precision and cannot establish recall.
uncertainty_policy: Partial coverage, unsupported formats, historical schema/venue/plan authority, dividend baselines, first disclosure, public timing and final action identity remain unresolved without evidence.
ownership_policy: Reuse frozen ownership parser; no expanded schema authority.
changes: Exclude heading-only, cross-reference-only and non-operative financial spin evidence
Preserve merger-proxy and combined proxy/prospectus-information-statement genres
Attach tightly scoped same-paragraph program facts with separate evidence citations
Distinguish printed dateline announcement from approval and unresolved public time
Keep another-authorization subtype uncertain and documentary subtype disagreements explicit
Retain multi-actor dated and undated prior-announcement reference flags
Preserve explicit actor/action/object separation plans in mixed financial-context sentences
